name: Push-Up
definition: A prone upper-body exercise where the body is lowered and pressed away from the floor while maintaining a rigid trunk.

name: Knee Push-Up
definition: A regressed push-up performed with the knees on the floor to reduce load while training the same pressing pattern.

name: Incline Push-Up
definition: A push-up performed with the hands elevated on a stable surface to reduce bodyweight load.

name: Decline Push-Up
definition: A push-up performed with the feet elevated to increase upper-chest and shoulder demand.

name: Wide Push-Up
definition: A push-up performed with the hands wider than shoulder width to increase chest emphasis.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
definition: A push-up performed with the hands closer than shoulder width to increase triceps demand.

name: Diamond Push-Up
definition: A close-hand push-up where the thumbs and index fingers form a diamond shape under the chest.

name: Pike Push-Up
definition: A bodyweight shoulder press pattern performed with hips high and the torso angled toward the floor.

name: Handstand Push-Up
definition: An advanced vertical pressing exercise performed from a handstand position by lowering and pressing the body upward.

name: Archer Push-Up
definition: A push-up variation where the body shifts toward one arm while the opposite arm stays straighter.

name: One-Arm Push-Up
definition: An advanced unilateral push-up performed with one hand supporting and pressing most of the bodyweight.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
definition: A push-up where one knee drives toward the same-side elbow during the lowering phase.

name: Hindu Push-Up
definition: A flowing push-up that moves from a pike-like position through a low scoop into an extended chest position.

name: Clap Push-Up
definition: An explosive push-up where the hands leave the floor briefly between repetitions.

name: Bodyweight Squat
definition: A bilateral lower-body exercise where the hips and knees flex to lower the body and extend to stand.

name: Sumo Squat
definition: A bodyweight squat performed with a wider stance and externally rotated hips.

name: Squat Hold
definition: An isometric squat position held near the bottom range to develop positional strength and mobility.

name: Wall Sit
definition: An isometric squat held with the back supported against a wall.

name: Jump Squat
definition: A squat performed explosively so the feet leave the floor during the upward phase.

name: Pistol Squat
definition: A single-leg squat where the non-working leg is held forward while the body lowers and rises on one leg.

name: Cossack Squat
definition: A lateral squat where one leg bends deeply while the other remains extended to the side.

name: Forward Lunge
definition: A split-stance lower-body exercise where one leg steps forward and the body lowers before returning to standing.

name: Reverse Lunge
definition: A lunge where one leg steps backward before the body lowers and returns to standing.

name: Walking Lunge
definition: A repeated forward lunge pattern where each step advances the body through space.

name: Lateral Lunge
definition: A frontal-plane lunge where one leg steps to the side while the opposite leg stays extended.

name: Curtsy Lunge
definition: A lunge where the moving leg crosses behind the stance leg before lowering.

name: Split Squat
definition: A stationary split-stance exercise where the body lowers and rises without stepping between repetitions.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
definition: A split squat performed with the rear foot elevated to increase front-leg loading.

name: Step-Up
definition: A unilateral lower-body exercise where one foot steps onto an elevated surface and drives the body upward.

name: Glute Bridge
definition: A supine hip-extension exercise where the hips lift from the floor by contracting the glutes.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
definition: A glute bridge performed with one foot on the floor and the opposite leg lifted.

name: Hip Thrust
definition: A hip-extension exercise performed with the upper back supported on an elevated surface and hips moving through a larger range.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
definition: A unilateral hip thrust performed with one foot driving into the floor while the upper back is supported.

name: Good Morning
definition: A hip-hinge exercise where the torso inclines forward from the hips while the spine remains controlled.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
definition: A unilateral hip-hinge where the torso tips forward as the non-stance leg extends behind the body.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
definition: A knee-flexion hamstring exercise where the body lowers forward from a kneeling position under eccentric control.

name: Calf Raise
definition: A lower-leg exercise where the heels lift by plantarflexing the ankles while standing.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
definition: A calf raise performed on one leg to increase unilateral ankle and calf demand.

name: Tibialis Raise
definition: A shin-strengthening exercise where the toes lift toward the shins while the heels stay grounded.

name: Pull-Up
definition: A vertical pulling exercise where the body is pulled upward from a hanging position with palms facing away.

name: Chin-Up
definition: A vertical pulling exercise where the body is pulled upward with palms facing toward the body.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
definition: A vertical pull performed with palms facing each other on parallel handles.

name: Negative Pull-Up
definition: A pull-up regression where the body starts at the top and lowers slowly under control.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
definition: A small-range vertical pulling drill where the shoulder blades depress and retract while the elbows stay straight.

name: Inverted Row
definition: A horizontal pulling exercise where the body hangs under a bar or handles and is pulled toward the anchor.

name: Dip
definition: A bodyweight pressing exercise where the body lowers between supports and presses back upward.

name: Bench Dip
definition: A dip regression performed with the hands supported behind the body on a stable elevated surface.

name: Muscle-Up
definition: An advanced bodyweight movement combining a pull-up transition and dip to move above a bar.

name: Plank
definition: An isometric core exercise where the body is held straight while supported by forearms or hands and toes.

name: High Plank
definition: A plank held at the top of a push-up position with arms straight.

name: Side Plank
definition: An isometric lateral core exercise where the body is held straight while supported on one forearm or hand.

name: Reverse Plank
definition: An isometric posterior-chain hold where the body faces upward and is supported by hands or forearms and heels.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
definition: A high plank variation where alternating hands tap the opposite shoulder while resisting trunk rotation.

name: Body Saw
definition: A plank variation where the body shifts forward and backward while maintaining trunk stiffness.

name: Mountain Climber
definition: A dynamic plank exercise where the knees alternately drive toward the chest.

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
definition: A mountain climber where each knee drives toward the opposite elbow to increase rotational core demand.

name: Dead Bug
definition: A supine core exercise where opposite arm and leg extend while the trunk resists arching.

name: Bird Dog
definition: A quadruped core exercise where opposite arm and leg extend while the trunk remains stable.

name: Crunch
definition: A trunk-flexion exercise where the upper back lifts from the floor by contracting the abdominals.

name: Bicycle Crunch
definition: A rotational crunch where the opposite elbow and knee move toward each other in an alternating pattern.

name: Reverse Crunch
definition: A core exercise where the pelvis curls toward the ribs to lift the hips from the floor.

name: Sit-Up
definition: A trunk-flexion exercise where the torso rises from lying to a seated position.

name: V-Up
definition: A core exercise where the arms and legs lift together to form a V shape at the top.

name: Leg Raise
definition: A supine core exercise where the legs lift and lower while the trunk controls pelvic position.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
definition: A hanging core exercise where the legs lift toward the torso while the upper body hangs from a bar.

name: Flutter Kick
definition: A supine core exercise where the legs alternate up and down with small controlled kicks.

name: Hollow Body Hold
definition: An isometric core hold where the body forms a curved hollow shape with arms and legs off the floor.

name: Russian Twist
definition: A seated rotational core exercise where the torso turns side to side while the trunk stays braced.

name: L-Sit
definition: An isometric support hold where the torso stays upright and the legs extend forward in an L shape.

name: V-Sit
definition: An advanced isometric hold where the legs are elevated higher than an L-sit while the body supports itself.

name: Burpee
definition: A full-body exercise combining a squat, plank transition, and jump into one continuous movement.

name: Squat Thrust
definition: A bodyweight conditioning exercise where the feet jump or step between a plank and squat stance without the final vertical jump.

name: Bear Crawl
definition: A crawling exercise performed on hands and feet with knees hovering near the floor.

name: Crab Walk
definition: A backward-facing crawling exercise where the body is supported on hands and feet with hips lifted.

name: Inchworm
definition: A bodyweight movement where the hands walk from a standing fold into a plank and back.

name: Jumping Jack
definition: A rhythmic full-body exercise where the legs jump apart and together while the arms move overhead and down.

name: High Knees
definition: A stationary locomotor exercise where the knees lift rapidly toward hip height in an alternating rhythm.

name: Butt Kicks
definition: A stationary locomotor exercise where the heels alternately move toward the glutes.

name: Skater Jump
definition: A side-to-side single-leg jumping exercise that trains lateral power and landing control.

name: Broad Jump
definition: A horizontal jumping exercise where the body projects forward from a two-foot takeoff and lands under control.

name: Tuck Jump
definition: A vertical jump where the knees lift toward the chest during the airborne phase.

name: Pogo Jump
definition: A low-amplitude repeated jump emphasizing quick ankle stiffness and minimal knee bend.

name: Donkey Kick
definition: A quadruped glute exercise where one bent leg lifts upward by extending the hip.

name: Fire Hydrant
definition: A quadruped hip exercise where one bent knee lifts out to the side while the pelvis stays controlled.

name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
definition: A hip-abduction exercise performed lying on the side while the top leg lifts upward.

name: Clamshell
definition: A side-lying hip exercise where the knees bend and the top knee opens while the feet stay together.

name: Back Extension
definition: A prone posterior-chain exercise where the chest lifts from the floor through controlled spinal extension.

name: Superman
definition: A prone exercise where the arms and legs lift from the floor to train the posterior chain isometrically.

name: Prone Y Raise
definition: A prone shoulder exercise where the arms lift in a Y shape to train lower-trap and shoulder control.

name: Prone T Raise
definition: A prone shoulder exercise where the arms lift out to the sides in a T shape.

name: Prone W Raise
definition: A prone shoulder exercise where the arms bend into a W shape and lift by squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Scapular Push-Up
definition: A straight-arm plank exercise where the shoulder blades protract and retract without bending the elbows.

name: Wall Handstand Hold
definition: An inverted isometric hold where the body is supported on the hands with the feet against a wall.

name: Handstand
definition: An inverted balance hold where the body is supported only by the hands.

name: Frog Stand
definition: A beginner arm-balance hold where the knees rest near the upper arms while the hands support the body.

name: Planche Lean
definition: A straight-arm strength drill where the shoulders lean forward past the hands while maintaining a plank-like body line.

name: Planche
definition: An advanced straight-arm hold where the body is held parallel to the floor with only the hands supporting it.

name: Front Lever
definition: An advanced hanging hold where the body stays horizontal facing upward while suspended from a bar or rings.

name: Back Lever
definition: An advanced hanging hold where the body stays horizontal facing downward while suspended from a bar or rings.

name: Human Flag
definition: An advanced lateral hold where the body is suspended sideways from a vertical support.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
definition: A prone shoulder-control exercise where the arms sweep from overhead toward the hips while lifted from the floor.

name: Cat-Cow
definition: A quadruped spinal-control exercise alternating between spinal flexion and extension.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
definition: A dynamic mobility exercise combining a deep lunge position with thoracic rotation.

name: Leg Swing
definition: A dynamic mobility exercise where one leg swings through a controlled range to prepare the hips and hamstrings.

name: Arm Circle
definition: A dynamic shoulder mobility exercise where the arms trace controlled circles through the shoulder joint.

name: Standing Toe Touch
definition: A bodyweight posterior-chain mobility exercise where the torso folds forward toward the feet.
